view_frame: The drawing uses third-angle projection with two primary views: TOP (XY) and FRONT (XZ). The world coordinate system is defined as X = width (horizontal in both views), Y = depth (vertical in TOP view), and Z = height (vertical in FRONT view). The origin (0,0,0) is located at the bottom-front-left corner of the block.

The outer envelope dimensions (60x40x20) are fixed unless explicitly edited; chamfering removes material from these bounds.
